decision_cruda.rationale: LH-05 is down (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 11:30 in place. Its stope has 253 t at 10 g/t, about 81 oz. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.5 oz/h and is 0.58 h away. It loads about 7.6 oz/h at 23.6 t/h. Central trucks have spare capacity (91 t/h vs 71 inflow). With LH-05 alone, about 180 t would be loaded by 17:00. With both loaders, all 253 t should be loaded. That is roughly +20 oz against a cost of about 3 oz. I chose LH-08 over LH-09, whose heading is worth 2 oz/h.
